print(r)
b = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n')
c = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
diffs = [(rr,cc,b[rr][cc],c[rr][cc]) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[rr][cc]!=c[rr][cc]]
print("changed:", len(diffs), "rows:", sorted(set(rr for rr,_,_,_ in diffs)))
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('b','c','M','Y'):
        print(n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels'], n['boundary'])
print("timer N:", c[0].count('N'))
</parameter>
</function>
